items.name: page-ui
items.title: NocoBase Plugin Registry Page Example
items.description: Application-owned page that overrides the UI Registry example plugin route.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-registry-example. The installed page is application-owned, and its extension overrides only the plugin route component. Review upgrades with a three-way merge.

items.name: component-ui
items.title: NocoBase Plugin Registry Component Example
items.description: Application-owned component that can be imported into any application surface.
items.docs: The installed component is application-owned and has no route or plugin runtime dependency. Import it through the installed item's index.ts.

items.name: provider-ui
items.title: NocoBase Plugin Registry Provider Example
items.description: Application-owned UI context provider and consumer hook.
items.docs: The installed provider is application-owned and has no route. Wrap the required application subtree with ExampleUiProvider and consume it through useExampleUi.
